reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis conflates grain-boundary pinning by solute segregation with pinning by oxide particles, and it is unclear how a thin surface oxide film would simultaneously pin internal grain boundaries to hinder dislocation motion; the mechanism is physically muddled.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if segregation is absent or no property improvement is seen, though it does not fully disentangle the dual role of the oxide film.
reasons.usefulness: The core idea of exploiting grain-boundary segregation to enhance both corrosion resistance and strength in lightweight HEAs is a useful direction, but the mechanistic confusion reduces its immediate value to a researcher.
